## Course channels

The course has group channels on **Telegram** and **Max** — the invite
links live on the Moodle page. Announcements land there first; questions
asked in the group reach everyone.

## Who to ask what

| Your question is about… | Ask |
|---|---|
| A lab exercise that won't pass, environment issues | The lab session itself (fastest), then the TA |
| Homework clarification | The Moodle forum thread for that HW — answers there reach everyone |
| A grade ([regrade policy](policies.qmd#grading)) | Written regrade request within 7 days |
| Project scope, topic, or a stuck experiment | Book a Thursday office-hours slot (bring the measured table you have, however small) |
| Exam logistics, accommodations, life events | The instructor, as early as possible — [late policy](policies.qmd#late-policy) |
| A broken link or typo on this site | The "Report an issue" link on any page — fixes land quickly |

One norm worth stating: questions asked in the open (group channel, forum,
lab room) outrank private messages for anything that isn't personal —
every answer in the open saves thirty people the same message, and the
course treats asking visible questions as a contribution, not an
imposition.
